definitions: A TypeScript-based open-source web application framework maintained by Google and a community of individuals and corporations. It is used for building single-page client-side applications.
The first version of Angular, known as AngularJS, was released in 2010. Subsequent versions, simply called Angular, were a complete rewrite and released in 2016.
examples: Many modern web applications are built with Angular.
He is learning Angular for front-end development.
The latest version of Angular includes new features.
